characters.name: Dharma Montgomery
characters.description: An eccentric yoga instructor and dog trainer. Calling Parents by Their Name: HerHippie Parentsraised her to call them by their first names, Larry and Abby. Cloudcuckoolander: Dharma's eccentric spirit and unconventional hobbies usually provide the contrast with her straight-laced husband Greg. Embarrassing Middle Name: Her middle name is "Freedom", which is considered strange. However, it fits Dharma's hippie parents and she does not find it embarrassing. Genki Girl: Dharma is the most energetic flower child you can imagine.

characters.name: Greg Montgomery
characters.description: Beware the Nice Ones: Greg is a good man whose non-confrontational upbringing make him slow to show his anger. But when pushed too far, he can and will respond with great force and fury. Big Brother Instinct: After Abby and Larry have a second baby, Greg quickly becomes very protective of his new brother-in-law, which mainly takes the form of trying to convince Abby and Larry not to name the kid something that will get him beat up in school. Control Freak: Greg always likes planning things and keeping everything in order, which sometimes causes arguments with Dharma. Embarrassing Middle Name: Clifford. After it's revealed, he is mortified and his own wife can't stifle a giggle. Happily Married: He and Dharma ara happy together. Most of the comedic tension of the show come from the antics of their friends and parents.

characters.name: Kitty Montgomery
characters.description: Jerk with a Heart of Gold: She's a bit manipulative/controlling, she may be kind of a snob and bit conservative but she adores her son and genuinely comes to care for Dharma and her family, in her own way. My Beloved Smother: Since the first episode, Kitty is portrayed as a controlling woman who is overly protective of her son Greg. Obnoxious In-Laws: To Dharma. Both sets of parents tend to be intrusive, but Kitty is the one who fits the stereotype the most, frequenly clashing with her daugher-in-law Dharma. Only Known by Their Nickname: Only Kitty. Even her husband Edward only calls her Katherine when he's issuing her an ultimatum. Rich Bitch: She represents the high-society elite and usually acts like a snob who looks down on the hippie lifestyle of Dharma and her parents.

characters.name: Edward Montgomery
characters.description: Dad the Veteran: Edward is a retired military man. Henpecked Husband: He is generally indifferent to his wife'sRich Bitchbehavior, and tries to avoid being involved with what she does. Only Sane Man: Along with his son Greg, he is one of the more normal characters. Although he has long since resigned himself to the insanity around him and occasionally joins in. Vitriolic Best Buds: With Larry, Dharma's father. Despite their disagreements and their contrasting lifestyles, they become good friends.

characters.name: Abby O'Neil
characters.description: Bourgeois Bohemian: She and Larry are a pair of eccentric former hippies now living comfortably in an expensive looking, if strangely appointed, apartment. Closer to Earth: Despite being an eccentric hippie, Abby is shown many times to be more mature than her husband Larry. Although that's not saying much. Granola Girl: Abby is a free-spirited New Age woman and a vegan. Hippie Parents: Along with Larry. They have a hippie lifestyle and raised their daughter Dharma to become a hippie like them. New-Age Retro Hippie: She and Larry are old-school hippies who raised Dharma to be one as well. They have a hodgepodge of Easter and Western mystical beliefs while Larry maintains a militant, anti-establishment mindset.

characters.name: Larry Finkelstein
characters.description: Bourgeois Bohemian: He and Abby are a pair of eccentric former hippies now living comfortably in an expensive looking, if strangely appointed, apartment. Cloudcuckoolander: Due to his memory lapses and odd beliefs, Larry is possibly even more outlandish than his daughter. Conspiracy Theorist: He often rants about several conspiracies involvingRichard Nixonor the FBI or the moon landing, etc... Genius Ditz: Despite being a clueless fool with a poor memory, Larry used to be a talented musician with a band before Dharma's birth. Hippie Parents: Along with Abby. They have a hippie lifestyle and raised their daughter Dharma to become a hippie like them.

characters.name: Jane Deaux
characters.description: Dharma's best friend. Cloudcuckoolander: Even weirder than Dharma. She and Dharma are frequently involved in odd schemes and weird stuff together. The Cynic: Jane is more cynical than the eternally optimistic Dharma. She also has a low opinion of men. Put on a Bus: She disappears after a single appearance in the fifth season.

characters.name: Pete Cavanaugh
characters.description: Greg's friend and co-worker. Deadpan Snarker: Being a pessimistic person who doesn't care about anything (besides hot women), he tends to react to life with sarcasm. Lazy Bum: Pete is a notoriously unmotivated slacker who doesn't take his job seriously. He is hired as a lawyer only thanks to his friend Greg. Politically Incorrect Hero: He is extremely sexist and doesn't even try to hide it. While not a "hero", Pete is still a friend of the protagonist. Self-Deprecation: Pete willingly admits that he is a terrible person, much to the dismay ofDharma, who tried and failed to find someHidden Depthsin Pete.
